passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: A good friend can listen, and a good friend can wait.
phrases.ko: 좋은 친구는 들을 수 있고, 기다릴 수도 있어요.

phrases.en: We share, and we play fair.
We are on one team, and we cheer for our team.
phrases.ko: 우리는 한 팀이고, 우리 팀을 응원해요.

phrases.en: We want to win, but we also want to be fair.
Tom can be kind, and he is my good friend.
phrases.ko: 톰은 친절할 수 있고, 나의 좋은 친구예요.

phrases.en: He listens when I am sad.
He will wait for me at the gate.
phrases.ko: 톰은 교문에서 나를 기다려 줄 거예요.

phrases.en: We share a snack after the game.
Our team cheers even when we do not win.
A kind friend makes a good team.
I want to be a good friend too.

full_passage_spoken: A good friend can listen, and a good friend can wait. We share, and we play fair. We are on one team, and we cheer for our team. We want to win, but we also want to be fair. Tom can be kind, and he is my good friend. He listens when I am sad. He will wait for me at the gate. We share a snack after the game. Our team cheers even when we do not win.
